name: employee-surveys-feedbackpulse
description: Design a company-specific employee survey in Cursor through a short guided chat. Build pulse or engagement surveys, add an eNPS question when it fits, and optionally save via OAuth as a template or an unlaunched draft. English only. This designs the survey. It does not launch it, send reminders, manage respondents, or show eNPS results from FeedbackPulse admin dashboard.
